units.source_text: 在这之前，杜子春的朋友们与他路不相识，没人愿意给他好言好语，但是在得到他有钱之后，便一个个主动上门拜访，日夜不离。

en.t: Before that, Du Zichun's friends acted as if they did not know him, and no one would offer him a kind word; but once they learned he had money, they came calling one after another and stayed by him day and night.

units.source_text: 而且来拜访的人数一天比一天多，短短的半年里，洛阳城中，有名有才的才子佳人，都是杜子春的府上常客。

en.t: Moreover, the number of visitors grew day by day, and within a mere half year all the famous and talented young men and women of Luoyang had become regular guests at Du Zichun's mansion.

units.source_text: 杜子春和这些嘉宾，每天都一起吃吃喝喝，酒宴之奢华用言语难以表达。

en.t: Du Zichun ate and drank with these guests every day, and the luxury of their feasts was beyond words.

units.source_text: 简而言之，就是这样的镜像，杜子春喝着西域美酒，看着天竺魔术师口吞大刀的表演，

en.t: In short, the scene was like this: Du Zichun drank fine wine from the Western Regions while watching an Indian magician swallow a great sword.

units.source_text: 四周莺莺燕燕二十名，其中十人头大都戴着翡翠莲花，十人戴着玛瑙牡丹花，他们弹琴吹笛，歌舞升平。

en.t: Around him were twenty graceful beauties: ten wore jade lotus flowers on their heads, and ten wore agate peonies; they played zithers and flutes, singing and dancing in splendid harmony.
